title: Local Observer State And Identity Preservation
summary: Local sampling and private archives preserve committed observation metadata and identity. Observer has no network delivery or Server receiver.
localQueueDisposition: Use outbox-export and outbox-verify with an explicit private archive destination. Export and verification do not change the original state, destination, acknowledgements or cursors.
identity: Preserve local binding, stream identity, destination metadata and any stored receipts when reading or exporting committed state. No operation repins a stream or treats an archive as remote acknowledgement.
recovery: Keep the original state and matching binary. Continue local sampling independently. Any fresh state namespace or disposition of an old queue requires an explicit owner decision.

localArchive.scope: Export exactly the committed bounded state to a private external file. Retries accept only identical bytes; verification preserves the original state, queue, source and index. No network request or receipt application is performed.
localArchive.safety: Require normalized absolute paths outside source, profiles, index and Observer state. Reject unsafe permissions, symlinks, stale or incomplete archives. Preserve stream identity, byte hash, queue bounds and explicit uncommitted-state exclusion.
localArchive.proof: Archive receipts describe a byte-exact local copy, not external durability, remote delivery or publication.
